g.text: intel(r) ethernet controller i226-v wired 1 Gbps rocket league found
7 of 13 stalls came with engine frame drops and the rest did not, so some are your machine and some are the path in and out.
what that feels like in game
a 451 ms stall is about 27 inputs that never reached the server on time. this is what makes the ball pass through your car: you
hit it on your screen, the server was still playing the last input it had, so the touch never happened for anyone else. your ping
does not move, because the delay is before the packet leaves your pc.
400 packets to EU1: 0.0% lost, 22 ms, 0.8 ms jitter, worst 30 ms.
so the stalls above happen on your pc, before anything is sent.
about the same, 0.3 stalls per minute against 0.4 before.
1 fixes target this. press fix, restart, then play another match and press in-game again to compare.
